metadata.title: Logarithmically Slim Polygons
metadata.abstract: We study the relationship between the large-scale geometry of a geodesic metric space and the slimness of its geodesic polygons. We show that if there is a uniform constant $\delta$ such that every geodesic polygon in an unbounded geodesic metric space is $\delta$-slim, then the space has asymptotic Assouad--Nagata dimension one. We further consider graphs of bounded valency and allow the slimness constant of an $n$-gon to grow logarithmically with $n$. More precisely, under an explicit logarithmic bound on the slimness of geodesic $n$-gons, we prove that the graph has asymptotic Assouad--Nagata dimension one. Thus, sufficiently strong logarithmic control on the slimness of geodesic polygons forces one-dimensional large-scale geometry. We also obtain two criteria for graphs, outside the hyperbolic setting, to have asymptotic Assouad--Nagata dimension one. In particular, these criteria show that one-dimensional large-scale geometry can be detected from quantitative restrictions on the slimness of geodesic polygons, without requiring the space to be hyperbolic.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 多边形细薄性对大尺度维数的约束
analysis.workSummary: 若无界测地空间的所有测地多边形共享一个细薄常数，作者证明其渐近Assouad–Nagata维数为1。对有界度图，在明确的、足够强的log n级n边形细薄上界下仍得维数1。
techniques: 有界度图的对数增长控制
analysis.breakthrough: 另给两条可在非双曲图中应用的判据，用多边形的定量限制识别一维大尺度结构。
analysis.limitations: 对数系数和图的局部有限度条件属于结论的重要部分，摘要未给常数。不能从任意log n上界直接推出维数1。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 连接双曲几何、覆盖维数和拟树性质，与比较几何主题密切。
